subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should standalone MCP entrypoints retain explicit adapter-specific stderr prefixes, or adopt one shared diagnostics envelope with a required adapter field?
rationale: Both shapes are mechanically feasible, but source inspection does not establish whether the current prefixes are intentional operator context or accidental format drift.

options.title: Preserve explicit prefixes
options.body: Keep the current adapter-identifying strings and close this cleanup unless a concrete parser or user-facing inconsistency is demonstrated.

options.title: Define shared envelope
options.body: Introduce one helper that requires an adapter identifier and migrate OpenClaw-tools, Codex-supervision, and plugin-tools diagnostics together with tests.

options.title: Use generic diagnostics
options.body: Replace adapter-specific prefixes with one generic format, accepting reduced source identification in combined stderr output.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit prefixes
recommendation.body: Keep the current adapter-identifying strings and close this cleanup unless a concrete parser or user-facing inconsistency is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the Codex supervision side makes this person the best available owner for confirming whether adapter identity is part of the diagnostics contract.
